Container.Name: CrushFTP
Container.Overview: CrushFTP 10 and 11 or CrushMFT 27, for FTP, FTPS, SFTP, HTTPS and WebDAV, in one container. On first start it downloads the version you choose into the Config folder, CrushMFT 27 unless CrushFTP version says 10 or 11, checks the download, and runs it as nobody:users. Each later start moves it to the vendor's newest build of that version; a newer major version only comes with CrushFTP upgrade. [br][br]The first administrator, crushadmin, gets a random password in admin-password.txt in the Config folder: open the web UI, sign in, change it, and delete the file. Each version needs its own license from the vendor; CrushMFT 27 has a free one. [br][br]Coming from the old CrushFTP 10 image: it kept resetting the administrator's password to a value anyone could know. The first start gives that administrator a new random password in admin-password.txt, once, and keeps your CrushFTP 10.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: The web UI and the admin pages, over HTTP.

Config.Name: HTTPS port
Config.Description: The web UI and the admin pages, over HTTPS.

Config.Name: SFTP port
Config.Description: SFTP. Unraid's own SSH server already listens on 22.

Config.Name: Second HTTP port
Config.Description: A second HTTP port CrushFTP opens.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: The CrushFTP folder: the program, settings, users, jobs, keys and logs, and admin-password.txt.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: A share to give users, such as /mnt/user/files. Give it to users in the admin pages as /mnt/FTP/Shared.

Config.Name: CrushFTP version
Config.Description: The version a new, empty Config folder gets: 27, 11 or 10. An installed one keeps its own.

Config.Name: CrushFTP upgrade
Config.Description: 11 or 27 moves an installed CrushFTP to that newer major version, which needs its own license.

Config.Name: CrushFTP updates
Config.Description: on moves the installed version to the vendor's newest build at each start; off runs the installed build without looking for a newer one.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: The first administrator's password, instead of a random one. Used once; crushadmin and other well-known passwords are refused.

Config.Name: Java memory
Config.Description: The most memory Java may use, such as 2g. Empty: half the container's memory.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user CrushFTP runs as and the Config folder belongs to.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group CrushFTP runs as and the Config folder belongs to.

Config.Name: Health check protocol
Config.Description: http or https, for the health check.

Config.Name: Health check port
Config.Description: The port the health check asks.
